tagline: 佳能便携相机，1995 年发布
description: 佳能于1995年推出的便携相机。配备32mm f/5.6 (3 elements in 3 groups)。快门速度Behind-the-lens mechanical shutter with single speed (1/125 sec.). No self-timer.。Two-step autofocus with near-infrared beam. 1 m to infinity.。

specs.快门: Behind-the-lens mechanical shutter with single speed (1/125 sec.). No self-timer.
specs.对焦: Two-step autofocus with near-infrared beam. 1 m to infinity.
specs.取景器: Albada reversed Galilean viewfinder with projected frame. 0.43x magnification and 80% coverage. Green OK-to-Shoot lamp on the right. Focusing mark.
specs.闪光灯: Guide number 10. Flash off/on switch. Flash range at ISO 100/200 flash auto mode: 1 m – 3 m. Flash charging time of approx. 5 sec. Red-eye reduction lamp provided.
specs.英文简介: The Canon Prima Junior AF (or simply AF 32 in America) is a budget compact autofocus camera released in 1995.
